bio.text: Marty Young is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2026 and graduated from the United States Military Academy in 1993.
Ballotpedia also lists graduate degrees from the Georgia Institute of Technology (2001) and New York University (2006), and a career as an executive.
